commitResults.messageTitle: Changed placeholder bot and msg
Add greeting
commitResults.messageBody:
Rename the main class to Nick and add a greeting message that
introduces the chatbot when it starts up.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for echo
commitResults.messageBody:
Read user commands in a loop and echo each one back. Exit the
loop when the user types the bye command.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for add and list
commitResults.messageBody:
Store text entered by the user in a fixed-size array and confirm
each addition with an added message. The list command prints the
stored items in a numbered list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for marking tasks as done
commitResults.messageBody:
Track the done status of each task and add a mark command that
sets a task as done. The list command now shows a status icon
for each task.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for unmarking tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Add an unmark command that reverses the done status of a task,
setting it back to not done.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task data into a Task class
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a separate Task class that holds a description and done
status, and expose methods to mark, unmark, and query it. Replace
the parallel arrays with a single array of Task objects.

commitResults.messageTitle: Comply with SE-EDU Java coding standard
commitResults.messageBody:
Add the required Javadoc header comments for the classes and public
methods so the code follows the SE-EDU Java coding standard. No
behaviour changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for todos, deadlines, and events
commitResults.messageBody:
Add three task types tracked with a type field on the Task class:
todos, deadlines (with a by time), and events (with a from and to
time). Update the add confirmation and list output to show the
type icon and any date details. Dates are kept as plain strings
for now.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use inheritance for task types
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses of Task, each
overriding the type icon and display format. This replaces the
single Task class that used a type field, so behaviour specific to
each task type now lives in its own class.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove duplicated reply formatting
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract a reply helper that wraps output lines between the two
divider lines, and a replyAdded helper for the add confirmation.
Previously every command repeated the divider printing inline,
which was duplicated logic that made the main loop noisy and easy
to get wrong. The command handlers now describe what to say rather
than how to frame it.

commitResults.messageTitle: Encapsulate task storage in a TaskList class
commitResults.messageBody:
Move the fixed-size task array and the running count into a new
TaskList class that exposes add, get, and size. Previously the main
loop managed the array and the count directly, which mixed storage
bookkeeping with command handling and duplicated the count++ logic
across every add branch. The main loop now works with a higher-level
task list abstraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract list rendering into its own method
commitResults.messageBody:
Move the code that builds the numbered task list out of the main
loop into a renderList method. Previously the list command mixed
loop control and array indexing with display formatting inside the
already long main method, making it read at an inconsistent level
of abstraction. The main loop now simply asks for the list lines
and prints them.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle empty todo and unknown command errors
commitResults.messageBody:
The chatbot assumes every command is well formed, so an empty todo
or an unrecognised command either adds a strange task or is silently
ignored. Introduce a NickException for invalid input and catch it in
the main loop so the user sees a clear OOPS message instead. Extract
command handling into a handle method so the error handling has a
single place to live.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle malformed deadline and event commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline and event parsing assumes the markers are always present, so
a missing /by, /from, or /to throws a confusing StringIndexOutOfBounds
crash, and a missing description produces an empty task. Validate the
markers and the extracted parts, and throw a NickException with a
specific message and example when something is missing.

Also pull the marker strings into named constants, since the raw
substring offsets were magic numbers that had to be kept in sync with
the marker text by hand.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid mark and unmark input
commitResults.messageBody:
Mark and unmark call Integer.parseInt directly and index into the
task array without checking, so a non-numeric argument crashes with
NumberFormatException and an out-of-range number crashes with
ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. Add a parseTaskNumber helper that
validates the argument is present, is a number, and refers to an
existing task, throwing a NickException with a specific message
otherwise. This keeps the two handlers short and gives the user
useful feedback instead of a stack trace.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-5
commitResults.messageBody:
Add error handling so the chatbot reports invalid input clearly
instead of crashing or silently misbehaving. Covers empty todos,
unknown commands, malformed deadline/event commands, and invalid
mark/unmark arguments.

commitResults.messageTitle: Organize classes into packages
commitResults.messageBody:
All classes sit in the default package, which does not scale as more
classes are added and goes against the coding standard of putting
every class in a package. Move the entry point and exception into a
nick package, and the task types and task list into a nick.task
package, keeping src/main/java as the source root. Add the package
declarations and the imports the entry point now needs.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-Packages
commitResults.messageBody:
Organize the classes into a nick package and a nick.task package,
keeping src/main/java as the source root.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use an ArrayList to store tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
The task list uses a fixed-size array capped at 100 tasks, which both
imposes an arbitrary limit and makes removing a task awkward. Switch
the internal storage to an ArrayList so the list grows as needed and
removal is straightforward, and add a remove method in preparation
for the delete command.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add delete command
commitResults.messageBody:
There is no way to remove a task once added, so a mistaken or
completed task stays in the list forever. Add a delete command that
removes the task at the given number and reports it, reusing the
existing parseTaskNumber helper so invalid or out-of-range numbers
are handled the same way as mark and unmark.

commitResults.messageTitle: Save tasks to disk when the list changes
commitResults.messageBody:
Tasks are kept only in memory, so everything is lost when the chatbot
exits. Add a Storage class that writes the tasks to data/nick.txt, and
a toSaveFormat method on each task type that encodes it as a pipe
separated line. Save after each successful command so the file always
reflects the current list. The parent folder is created if missing.
This commit covers the happy path for writing; reading is added next.

commitResults.messageTitle: Load saved tasks on startup
commitResults.messageBody:
Saved tasks are written to disk but never read back, so a restart
always starts with an empty list. Add a load method to Storage that
reads each line, parses it back into the matching task type, and
restores its done status. Call it when the chatbot starts, falling
back to an empty list if the file cannot be read (e.g. on first run).

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle missing and corrupted data files
commitResults.messageBody:
Loading assumes the data file exists and that every line is well
formed, so a first run (no file) relies on an exception and a
corrupted line crashes with an index out of bounds. Check for the
file up front and return an empty list if it is absent, and skip any
line that does not parse into a valid task instead of aborting the
load. This covers the first-run case and the corrupted-file stretch
goal.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-6
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a delete command to remove tasks, and switch the task list to an
ArrayList so it grows as needed (A-Collections).

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-7
commitResults.messageBody:
Save tasks to disk whenever the list changes and load them on startup,
with handling for a missing or corrupted data file.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Gradle build with fat JAR support
commitResults.messageBody:
The project has no build tooling, so there is no easy way to package
it for distribution. Add a Gradle build using the shadow plugin, with
the application main class set to nick.Nick, so that ./gradlew
shadowJar produces an executable fat JAR (nick.jar) that can be run
with java -jar. Include the Gradle wrapper so the build runs without a
local Gradle install.
